summary: Grab Holdings filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on September 15, 2026, announcing its intention to execute the remaining approximately $900 million of its authorized share repurchase programs over the next 12 months, funded from existing cash reserves. If fully executed, cumulative repurchases since the 2024 program inception would reach roughly $1.75 billion, the full board-authorized amount; at current market prices this implies repurchasing over 10% of Class A ordinary shares outstanding. Gross cash liquidity was $7.4 billion and net cash $5.4 billion as of June 30, 2026. Watch execution pace, buyback-driven float reduction and any program amendment risk.
